name: Topple
description: A physics toy with a sling: knock down towers of wood, glass, stone and metal across four levels - by day, in a desert, at night under swinging lamps, and against a windmill. 2D lights and shadows on normal-mapped sprites, joints (ropes, a catapult, a motor, a pulley trap), breakable blocks, particles, parallax, a full interface and sound. Also runs in a browser, phones included.
author: Duarte Peixinho
